title: CMA metric catalog
description: One entry per figure the Workspace shows: every tile, count, column, bar and exported column, on every page and in the JSON API. The catalog describes the code as it is; a difference from the docs or the intended definition is reported in the entry's status and notes and in docs/metrics/AUDIT-2026-10-23.md, never fixed here. METRICS.md is generated from catalog.json by web/scripts/metrics-doc.mjs and never edited by hand; web/verify/metrics.mjs validates this file against this schema.

key.description: Stable dotted key, e.g. calls.outbound_connected_rate; the page's anchor (#key)

surface.description: Where the figure lives; a figure an API answers that no page shows is api; configuration covers the Configuration group's own figures (System health)

page.description: The route that shows the figure, or the API route or download route that answers it

tile.description: The label as shown on screen (tile, column header or chart title), or the column name in a file; null for a figure no page shows

nl.description: Only where the app's i18n already gives one; null otherwise

definition.description: Plain words: what the number means to Kira or Arno

formula.description: The formula as the code computes it, in SQL-like pseudo or the exact expression; numerator and denominator named; what is excluded

unit.description: The brief's base units plus the ones the figures needed: days, business_days, date, average, text and flag

grain.description: One or more grains; the brief's base list plus the dimensions the figures needed

fed_by.description: The exact path: webhook event name → ingest service → function, or poll name → function, or scheduler job → function, or the Workspace's own write path

cadence.description: seconds, "every minute", "every 10 s while the tab is open", "on page load", or "configured outside the repo: <where>, to confirm"

filters.description: Everything the code applies: tenant (RLS), counted lines, counted forms, counted mailboxes, pipelines, test exclusions, period boundaries

time.description: The zone the business date uses, the business hours source, the ISO week rule, how now is defined, how a running period is handled

comparison.description: The previous-period rule, the history-start rule, when "No history to compare yet" shows; null for a figure without a comparison

default.description: The catalog default as the migration seeds it

pulse4all.description: The Pulse4all value from the seeds (02 for prod; the dev value from 03 named when it differs)

anyOf.description: Permission keys; holding any one of them shows the figure

perPerson.description: The reports.per_person key that must also be on for the tenant, where it applies

refresh.description: How the page gets the figure (on load, 10 s poll, snapshot age) and the snapshot's cadence where one exists

object.description: Function or view name, e.g. cma.calls_overview

verify_sql.description: A Studio query, parameterised with :tenant_id and the period's :from and :to as business dates, that recomputes the figure from the base tables in cma without the function or view the page uses; null only with a note saying why a faithful independent recomputation is not possible and what the closest check is

fixture_check.description: Whether verify_sql was run against the local volume fixture or the mock data and whether the value matched the page's; or why it was not run here (Martin runs it in Studio)

prerequisites.description: The Data first items (kpis.md 11) the figure depends on, each with the data-quality check that exposes it, null when no check does

docs.description: The sections in features.md, kpis.md, api.md and the data-model file that describe the figure

notes.description: Everything the reviewer needs: where code and docs differ, where two pages compute the same figure differently, zero and empty states, silent assumptions
